text: Does the kitchen have everything you need, like a stove and a refrigerator?
There's a stove, but not a refrigerator. I need to buy one.
You don't have a bed in your bedroom?
Well, I have a TV. But for now, I only have a mattress on the floor.
We don't have much furniture yet. We don't even have a sofa in the living room.
Hey. I've one I can sell you.
The bathroom is very small. There's just a shower and a toilet.
You can come and take a bath at my place any time.
